extras.logout.reasons: Telegram ended this session. This usually happens when the session was terminated from another device or the IP address changes often (for example, when a VPN is turned on and off).
extras.menu.addAccountRowInfo: The row is there with a single account too, not only from two
extras.menu.adminListsForAllAdminsInfo: Any admin sees «Administrators», «Subscribers» and «Members» in the profile, not only those who can ban
extras.menu.administratorsMenuItemInfo: An item in the «…» menu of a group's profile, for every member
extras.menu.archiveInChatMenuInfo: Long press on a chat in the list: «Archive» / «Unarchive»
extras.menu.autolockFiveSecondsInfo: One more option in Telegram's auto-lock menu
extras.menu.bioLinksInfo: Any link in a bio or a group description is tappable without Premium
extras.menu.cacheFooter: Telegram removes old files by itself when the cache reaches its limit or the keep time ends.
extras.menu.discussionButtonInfo: In the header of a channel you can message, the discussion button stays next to “Message”
extras.menu.extraCacheOptionsInfo: 1 GB cache limit and 1 hour media keeping in «Data and Storage»
extras.menu.extraLanguagesInfo: Chinese variants, Japanese, Vietnamese, Hindi and Armenian in Telegram's language list
extras.menu.extraMuteDurationsInfo: 4 hours, 8 hours and 1 day in a profile's «Notifications»
extras.menu.hiddenPinnedMenuItemInfo: Brings the pinned message back after its bar was closed
extras.menu.hideAccountInNotifications: Don't Name the Account in Notifications
extras.menu.hideAccountInNotificationsIn: With several accounts a notification does not show which account it came to
extras.menu.hidePremiumOffersInfo: No banners about gifting, buying or renewing Premium above the chat list
extras.menu.hideRepostToStoryInfo: No repost-to-story button in the share sheet
extras.menu.languageFooter: These are community translations on Telegram's translation platform; Telegram loads them as it does from a t.me/setlanguage link.
extras.menu.linkMenuShareInfo: In the menu of a long-pressed link
extras.menu.linkPreviewOpensMediaInfo: A tap on the picture of a preview opens it, not the link
extras.menu.logoutReasonInfo: When Telegram ends the session, the alert names the likely reasons
extras.menu.mentionChainInfo: Long press a suggestion: @name and a new @ right away for the next one
extras.menu.moreBrowsersInfo: «In-App Safari» and «System Browser» in Telegram's browser settings
extras.menu.noRecordTooltipInfo: A tap on the microphone or camera does not show «Hold to record»
extras.menu.qrLoginAlwaysInfo: «Link Desktop Device» in «Devices» even when the server hides it
extras.menu.recentActionsShortcutInfo: For admins: a row in a channel's profile and an item in the «…» menu of groups and channels
extras.menu.restrictUntilTimeInfo: «Restrict until…» picks a time, not only a day
extras.menu.restrictionReasonCodeInfo: Under the text of an unavailable chat or message — its code, for example porn-ios
extras.menu.searchPartialWordsInfo: When a search in a chat finds nothing, it looks for the text inside words of the messages on the device
extras.menu.selectionPanelButtonsInfo: «Save to Saved Messages» and «Forward Without Author» on the selection panel instead of «Report» (it stays in the message menu)
extras.menu.sessionDetailsInfo: Session details show its IP address and the app's api_id
extras.menu.sessionsFooter: Applies to «Devices» in Telegram's Privacy and Security.
extras.menu.systemShareSheetInfo: «Share» opens the iOS sheet at once, wherever sharing outside the app is allowed
extras.menu.youTubePictureInPictureInfo: YouTube videos can go to PiP even when the server turned it off
